subject.title: fix(gateway): cap pendingFinalDelivery retries and prevent delivery wedge

question: After identity-safe restart recovery reaches the retry cap, should OpenClaw permanently clear the exhausted final or preserve a terminal failed-delivery record for operator recovery?
rationale: The replacement-state race has a narrow mechanical repair, but tests cannot decide the durable availability-versus-message-retention contract or its operator-facing recovery expectations.

options.title: Bounded identity-safe cleanup
options.body: Clear only the exact exhausted final after ten attempts and emit prominent diagnostics without affecting a replacement delivery.

options.title: Retain terminal failed state
options.body: Stop automatic retries at the cap while preserving the payload and failure metadata for explicit operator recovery.

recommendation.title: Bounded identity-safe cleanup
recommendation.body: Clear only the exact exhausted final after ten attempts and emit prominent diagnostics without affecting a replacement delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of this scheduler and the current restart-recovery documentation makes this the strongest available decision route.
